description.value: Golden Seafood Restaurant (金福源) is a Chinese dim sum and seafood restaurant on Nanaimo Street in East Vancouver, serving traditional dim sum alongside dinner specialties including Peking duck. The restaurant offers both dine-in and takeout options, including party trays suited for groups, making it a practical food stop for cyclists passing through the neighbourhood. OSM notes limited wheelchair accessibility on site.
